title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook: Exploratory Data Analysis
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Does not enumerate all analytical practices.

title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Engineering-statistics focus; not a universal analytics taxonomy.

title: NIST Measurement Process Characterization
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Measurement-process scope only.

title: NIST Process Improvement and Experimental Design
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Does not cover every modern experimental design.

title: NIST Process or Product Monitoring and Control
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Statistical process-control scope, not all anomaly analytics.

title: NIST Process Improvement
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Not a complete root-cause taxonomy.

title: NIST Assessing Product Reliability
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Product-reliability focus; survival/event-history coverage requires more sources.

title: Process Mining Manifesto
publisher: IEEE Task Force on Process Mining
limitations: Foundation source; later object-centric and predictive practices require additional evidence.

title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice, third edition
limitations: Primarily time-series forecasting; not all forecasting traditions.

title: Operations Research and Analytics
limitations: High-level methodology anchor; individual practices require primary technical sources.

title: Operations Research Methodologies: Simulation
limitations: High-level historical overview.

title: Operations Research journal editorial statement
limitations: Journal scope is not a formal type taxonomy.

title: Google Operations Research Tools reference manuals
limitations: Implementation surface is evidence of solver capabilities, not a universal taxonomy.

title: OR-Tools routing search strategies
limitations: Routing-specific strategy vocabulary; broader heuristic families need independent sources.

title: OGC Standards and Resources
limitations: Interoperability standards do not enumerate all spatial analytical practices.

title: SDMX Information Model
limitations: Statistical data exchange model, not a calculation taxonomy.

title: OpenDocument OpenFormula
limitations: Formula semantics only.

title: Google Analytics event model
limitations: Vendor-specific event collection model; does not define a universal user, session, journey or behavioral-causality contract.

title: Causal Diagrams for Epidemiologic Research
limitations: Graphical identification foundation only; does not enumerate every causal design, estimator or transportability condition.

title: IEEE Control Systems Society field of interest
limitations: Defines the field boundary, not exact control-analysis methods, safety cases or implementation contracts.

title: Conceptual Framework for Managerial Costing
limitations: Managerial-costing scope only; performance engineering, FinOps and physical resource measurement remain separate.

title: The KDD Process for Extracting Useful Knowledge from Volumes of Data
limitations: Foundational KDD process framing; later mining methods and production governance require additional evidence.

title: ISO/IEC 25012:2008 Data quality model
limitations: General retained-data quality model; telemetry observability, reconciliation authority and industry-specific quality remain separate.

title: The Use of Models: Experience and Prospects
publisher: Nobel Prize Outreach / Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
limitations: Econometric model-building foundation; does not enumerate modern panel, causal, time-series or microeconometric methods.

title: The Analysis, Synthesis, and Description of Biological Images
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Historical image-processing foundation and biological-image focus; not a current complete image/video analytics taxonomy.

title: Text REtrieval Conference
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Evaluation infrastructure and task evidence; does not own all search, text-analysis or content-understanding semantics.

title: Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management (SR 26-2)
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
limitations: Banking supervisory scope; model fitness, validation and authority remain context-specific outside covered institutions.

title: Statistical Mechanics of Complex Networks
limitations: Complex-network topology and dynamics review; graph databases, knowledge semantics and domain authority are outside its scope.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Voluntary AI-risk framework; measurement outcomes do not themselves authorize deployment or establish universal fairness metrics.

title: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: Voluntary privacy-risk framework; privacy is distinct from security, fairness and legal compliance, and version 1.1 remains under development.

title: SPECpower_ssj2008 Power and Performance Methodology
limitations: Server power/performance benchmark methodology; does not define universal latency, capacity, cost or energy analytics.

title: IEEE Signal Processing Society field of interest
limitations: Field scope spans many signal modalities but does not enumerate exact acquisition, estimation, detection or conformance contracts.

title: United Nations National Quality Assurance Frameworks Manual for Official Statistics
limitations: Official-statistics quality framework; individual survey designs, estimators and national authority remain separately governed.
